behaviour_slot_details.source: renderer 2257600-2258100 (component Xdt -> C_ -> ct slots), translation bindings.behaviors.behavior_slots
behaviour_slot_details.notes: A slot only unlocks once every behaviour it dependsOn has a bound action. DB behaviour values handled by class Ca: press, tap, hold, double_tap, tap_hold; convertToAdvanced() rewrites a 'press' row into 'tap'+'hold' rows and convertToSimple() collapses back to 'press', but no UI slot is labelled 'tap' in 1.25.1 (advancedBehaviors and behaviorToggle flags are defined and never read). Every action type except 'value' (and the module-only 'static:layer_*') is droppable on every key slot: key, modifier, shortcut_alias, combo, bluetooth, out, LED, naya, trans, none, mouse, layer_polite_hold, layer_polite_toggle, layer_rude_toggle, layer_polite_oneshot. Base layer (orderId 0) shows '(Disabled)' when all slots are empty.

chord_grammar.source: class $s renderer 1956953-1958600; sort order V6 at 1958560
chord_grammar.grammar: <MOD> [+ <MOD> ...] [+ <NONMOD>] joined with ' + ' (single spaces); modifiers first, sorted in fixed order LGUI, RGUI, LCTRL, RCTRL, LALT, RALT, LSHFT, RSHFT; at most one non-modifier key; a bare modifier list without key is allowed.
chord_grammar.actionType_written: combo when the code contains '+'; key when a single non-modifier; modifier when a single modifier; none otherwise ($s.getActionType). Palette Integrations entries keep actionType shortcut_alias with context 'MacOS Alias' | 'Windows Alias' | 'VSCode Alias'.
how_built: drag a Modifiers-group item onto a slot already holding a key/modifier/combo (onActionComboDropped, 2256020)
press the slot's record button and type the chord (Hdt hook 2241237 + Udt DOM-code map 2239270)
chord_grammar.app_shortcut_catalog_note: NayaFlow 1.25.1 has no per-application shortcut catalog; the only chords offered are the 211 Integrations records (MacOS 44, Windows 60, VS Code Presets 31, VS Code Presets (Mac) 76). docs/reference/app-shortcuts.json (ShortcutMapper/CreateCompanion) is this project's own data and is not referenced anywhere in the NayaFlow bundle; the string 'app_shortcut' in the renderer (263585) is only a Material icon name.

feature_flags.source: const f0t renderer 2714990-2715600, consumed via Dn(name) => flags[name].enabled
feature_flags.notes: Flags actually read (Dn/grep count > 1): colorMapping, keyMapping, macros, moduleConfigurations, layerManagement, bugReport, help, settings, moduleBindingSlots, dynamicLayers, signIn, backwardAndForward, undoAndRedo. basicActions/extendedActions/layersActions/modulesActions/integrationsActions/customActions/ledToggle/behaviorToggle/viewToggle/basicLayers/advancedBehaviors are defined but never read, so integrationsActions:false does NOT hide the Integrations tab (ck lists it unconditionally). macros:false hides the Macros nav page; palette macro entries are additionally empty because macroListProvider returns [] and the catalog has no macro record.

module_gesture_bindings.source: renderer 2380400-2392000 (touch gesture editor) and zlt module palette 2102723
module_gesture_bindings.note: Module (touch/track/tune) gesture slots use the same catalog plus the Modules tab. Axis gestures (vertical/horizontal/pinch&spread) disallow key, modifier, bluetooth, naya, led, out, mouse and static:layer_* (so effectively only 'value' codes such as 'mouse - MOUSE_DOWN - MOUSE_UP'); tap/double_tap/swipe/pinch/spread gestures disallow 'value' and static:layer_*. Layer actions in the module palette are 'static:layer_*' with numeric slot ids 0..35, shown only for Track modules. Module binding rows carry actionType mouse/value/key/modifier/shortcut_alias/LED/bluetooth/out/naya as the catalog spells them.

uncertain: Server-side filter semantics of GET /api/actions (params t=tab, g=group, d=displayContext list) are inside the Go binary flow-bg-server.exe and were inferred, not read: the renderer sends lower-case ids ('function Keys', 'configuration toggles', 'japanese-light') while the catalog stores 'Function Keys', 'Configuration Toggles', 'Japanese-Light', so matching must be case-insensitive; the record displayContext is a comma list matched against ['All', 'US'|'japanese-light'].
46 catalog records (exe offsets inside 6597632-7126676) carry only an id and null everything else -- placeholders, ignored.

Integrations chords whose tokens are not palette key codes (may not encode on device): WIN_PREV_OPEN_APP="[LALT] + TAB"; WIN_NEXT_OPEN_APP="[LALT] + LSHIFT + TAB"; WIN_DISPLAY_PROPERTIES="LALT + ENTER"; VS_DEF_INSERT_CURSOR="LALT + CLICK"; VS_DEF_SELECT_MATCHES="LALT + ENTER"; VS_MAC_INSERT_LINE_ABOVE="LGUI + LSHIFT + ENTER"; VS_MAC_INSERT_LINE_BELOW="LGUI + ENTER"; VS_MAC_FULLSCREEN="LGUI + CTRL + F"; VS_MAC_TERMINAL_PAGE_UP="PAGE_UP"; VS_MAC_TERMINAL_PAGE_DOWN="PAGE_DOWN"

Key-recording map Udt (renderer bytes 2239270-2241237) emits codes that differ from catalog codes: CapsLock->CAPS_LOCK (catalog CAPSLOCK), ScrollLock->SCROLL_LOCK (catalog SCROLLLOCK), Escape->ESCAPE (catalog ESC), PageUp/PageDown->PAGE_UP/PAGE_DOWN (catalog PG_UP/PG_DN); the map key 'print' never matches the DOM code 'PrintScreen', so PRINTSCREEN cannot be recorded; NumpadEnter/NumpadDecimal are unmapped. Recorded bindings are stored with these raw codes and actionType key/modifier/combo.

Renderer group ids 'MacOS Gesture', 'Windows Gesture', 'VS Code Presets (Windows)' exist in const ck but the catalog has zero records for them; bY returns null for an empty group, so they are invisible. Not counted as key actions.

Palette groups with tab 'Extended' / group 'Cursor' (MOUSE_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT, SCROLL_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT, frontendType mouse) are in the catalog but no palette component requests group 'cursor'; classified as not reachable. If a later build adds the group they would become key actions (type 'mouse' is allowed on key slots).
The catalog records use frontendType 'LED' (upper-case) and 'trans'/'none'/'naya'/'out'; the renderer lower-cases actionType only for comparisons, so DB rows are written with the catalog spelling.

Combos: dropping a modifier on a key-bound slot (or key on modifier, modifier on modifier, key on modifier-only combo) and the record button both write actionType 'combo' with code 'MOD [+ MOD...] + KEY' (renderer 2255400-2257500, class $s at 1956953). 'combo' is not in the caller's observed DB actionType list; palette Integrations entries write 'shortcut_alias' instead.

MODULE_FORCE_CHARGING is the only 'Configuration Toggles' entry; its icon key is MODULE_FORCE_CHARGE (no MODULE_FORCE_CHARGING icon). BT_OUT uses icon RF_DEVICE. LSHIFT/RSHIFT use icons LSHFT/RSHFT. These are icon-name mismatches, not missing actions.
